name: Doc Toolkit
description: Local-first document toolkit: digest a .docx/.xlsx/.pptx/.pdf/.csv/.md/.html file, then pull bounded windows (text / rows / slides) on demand instead of loading whole files into the conversation.

tokenBudget.note: Two tools only. Heavy parsing (docx/xlsx/pptx/pdf) stays inside the local runtime; callers pay for a digest (~1 KB) instead of the file.
